items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jerry had substituted for Paul a few times when Paul was unable to play. There just always was an easy musical relationship.

ctx.x: They both married Mills [College] girls. You remember?

I had forgotten about that. Jerry had substituted for Paul a few times when Paul was unable to play. There just always was an easy musical relationship. You can tell him the story about how George Wein induced you to go Mexico. That’s really how it began.
George had a festival in Mexico.
